fields.description: Which real DocType this chunk was extracted from, e.g. 'DMS Document Version' — the permission boundary a retrieval query must check (via frappe.get_list(user=...) on this DocType) before this chunk may ever be returned to a caller.
fields.label: Source DocType

fields.description: The exact real record this chunk's text was extracted from (e.g. one DMS Document Version).
fields.label: Source Reference

fields.description: Denormalized parent DMS Document code, for citation display without an extra lookup.
fields.label: Document Code

fields.description: Version metadata (master plan §13.9's 'Version metadata' requirement) — which revision of the source document this chunk came from.
fields.label: Version No

fields.description: A MOCK embedding vector (fixed-dimension hashed bag-of-words term-frequency vector — see rag_pipeline.mock_embed()), stored as a JSON list of floats. NOT a real embedding-model output — this platform makes no live embedding-provider calls, mirroring ai_core._call_provider_adapter()'s own honest mock-LLM disclosure.
fields.label: Embedding (JSON)

fields.description: The source record's status AT INDEX TIME (e.g. 'Effective', 'Obsolete', 'Draft') — a snapshot, kept in sync by re-indexing on every source revision/status change, never inferred live at query time.
fields.label: Source Status (at index time)

fields.description: 1 only when this chunk's source was genuinely CURRENT (Effective) at last index time. Retrieval MUST filter on this — master plan §13.9: 'Không index nội dung obsolete như current knowledge' (never serve Obsolete content as current).
fields.label: Is Current
